message: The rain outside still hadn't stopped.

name: Xia
message: The last train hasn't left yet.

name: Lin
message: Didn't you say it wouldn't rain today?

name: Xia
message:
I meant tomorrow.
I didn't even check today's forecast.
He handed Lin the umbrella, then stepped back beneath the eaves.

name: Xia
message: {player}, go on ahead. I'm still waiting for someone.
The rain drowned out her quiet ‘thank you’.
